world.title: The Russia-China gas deal India was waiting for - and how it directly impacts your wallet
world.summary: Russia and China are advancing the 'Power of Siberia 2' gas pipeline deal amid ongoing geopolitical tensions, particularly in the Strait of Hormuz. This agreement could significantly alter global energy flows, impacting supply and prices. As energy markets experience disruptions and volatility, the deal is particularly relevant for countries like India, which are closely monitoring these developments.

world.title: Iran claims unused modern weapons ready if US resumes attacks
world.summary: An Iranian military source stated that Iran has developed modern weapons that remain unused in combat against the US and Israel. The source warned that if the US resumes strikes, Iran would not "act with restraint." This statement was made to the Russian state-owned outlet RIA Novosti, emphasizing Iran's readiness to respond to potential attacks.

world.title: This country is turning an entire airport into a Pokémon world and fans are already planning tips
world.summary: Japan is transforming a regional airport into a Pokémon-themed attraction, appealing to fans and tourists alike. This initiative aims to enhance the travel experience by incorporating Pokémon elements throughout the airport. Enthusiasts are already planning visits to enjoy the unique environment. The project reflects Japan's ongoing efforts to innovate and attract visitors through popular culture and themed experiences.

business.title: Stocks to watch, May 21: Engineers India, ITC, Reliance Industries, LIC, Lenskart, Anant Raj, IGIL
business.summary: Lenskart Solutions reported an 8.49% year-on-year decline in consolidated net profit for Q4 FY26, totaling ₹200.28 crore. Stocks to watch include Engineers India, ITC, Reliance Industries, LIC, Lenskart, Anant Raj, and IGIL. Nvidia's earnings are also significant, as its GPUs support most AI workloads and large-scale data centers globally, attracting considerable market attention.

business.title: Lost Your H-1B Job In US? Here's What Indian Workers Can Do Before 60-Day Deadline Ends
business.summary: Indian professionals on H-1B visas facing layoffs in the U.S. must navigate a 60-day deadline to secure their status. With many already in lengthy green card queues, job loss can significantly impact their career trajectories, family stability, and long-term settlement aspirations. Options include seeking new employment, changing visa status, or exploring other immigration pathways to maintain residency.

business.title: 60-Day H1B Deadline Pushes Laid Off Indians Into Panic
business.summary: The shift to AI systems has led to significant layoffs in tech companies like Meta, Amazon, and Oracle, affecting many H-1B visa holders. With a 60-day deadline to secure new employment, laid-off Indian workers are facing increased anxiety. The situation highlights the vulnerabilities of H-1B visa holders amid changing industry dynamics and the growing reliance on artificial intelligence.

technology.title: Apple Unveils Enhanced Accessibility with Apple Intelligence
technology.summary: Apple plans to enhance its accessibility features in 2026, leveraging Apple Intelligence to improve user experience across iPhone, Vision Pro, and future devices. These updates aim to promote inclusivity, making technology more accessible for individuals with disabilities. The initiative reflects Apple's commitment to integrating advanced technology into its products, ensuring that all users can benefit from its innovations.

technology.title: Android 17's media player carousel gets a card-based redesign in QPR1 Beta 3
technology.summary: Android 17 QPR1 Beta 3 introduces a card-based redesign for its media player carousel. This update enhances the user interface of the media controls, which are vital to the Android experience. While not a complete overhaul, the redesign aims to improve usability and aesthetics, reflecting Google's ongoing efforts to refresh key elements of the Android operating system.

technology.title: Android Auto to get a major design change, widgets, better music apps
technology.summary: Google announced a significant update for Android Auto during the Google I/O 2026 event. The new version will feature a refreshed design, enhanced music applications, and support for widgets. It will also adapt to various display sizes and shapes, improving user experience. These changes aim to make Android Auto more versatile and user-friendly for drivers.

sports.title: The forgotten IPL OG: How cricket repaid Manish Pandey in Kolkata
sports.summary: Manish Pandey, a veteran of all 19 IPL seasons, has faced limited opportunities, batting only 28 times in six years. However, during a crucial match at Eden Gardens, he made a significant impact as Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) aimed for playoff qualification. His consistent presence in the league highlights the importance of players who contribute when it matters most.

sports.title: BCCI worried whether Rohit Sharma can stay fit till 2027 ODI World Cup
sports.summary: The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) is concerned about Rohit Sharma's fitness ahead of the 2027 ODI World Cup. As selectors prepare for the upcoming tournament in South Africa, they are evaluating Sharma's ability to maintain his physical condition. The situation has intensified discussions regarding the team's future strategy and player selection in light of Sharma's fitness.

sports.title: Netravalkar, Ugarkar rip through Scotland as USA cruise to commanding win
sports.summary: Saurabh Netravalkar led a strong bowling performance as the USA defeated Scotland by six wickets in a one-sided match. Chasing a target of 170, the USA's top order efficiently handled the modest total, finishing the game with nearly 23 overs remaining. This victory marked a significant achievement for the USA in their cricketing campaign against Scotland.

health.title: Ebola outbreak: Centre reviews preparedness as death toll crosses 100 in DR Congo, Uganda
health.summary: Union Health Secretary Punya Salila Srivastava led a high-level meeting with health secretaries from all states and Union territories to assess preparedness and response strategies for the Ebola virus disease. This meeting was prompted by the rising death toll, which has surpassed 100 in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, highlighting the urgent need for effective measures.

health.title: WHO Warns of Growing Emergency, ETHealthworld
health.summary: The World Health Organization has reported that the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has been ongoing for two months, resulting in over 130 deaths. The WHO emphasizes the need for urgent action to contain the outbreak, warning that it may continue to expand if not addressed promptly. The situation is classified as a growing emergency.

health.title: India on High Alert as Deadly Ebola Outbreak Spreads Across Central Africa
health.summary: India has heightened screening and surveillance measures in response to the World Health Organization's declaration of a global health emergency due to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Although no cases have been reported in India, the death toll in Congo has exceeded 130, raising concerns about the spread of a rare virus strain.

science.title: Who Invented the Telescope?
science.summary: The telescope's invention is attributed to various figures, notably Dutch spectacle maker Hans Lippershey, who filed a patent on October 2, 1608, for a two-lens device. Galileo Galilei later improved the design, significantly advancing astronomy. Competing claims exist regarding its origins, highlighting contributions from different inventors and the impact of these developments on the field of observational science.

science.title: Tent5a Enzyme Regulates Insulin Production by Controlling Polyadenylation of Insulin mRNA
science.summary: A study in Nature Communications highlights the enzyme Tent5a's role in regulating insulin production in pancreatic beta cells. Researchers found that Tent5a controls the polyadenylation of insulin mRNA, which is essential for insulin synthesis. This discovery could have implications for understanding diabetes and developing new treatments, as it reveals a key mechanism in insulin regulation and production.

science.title: Bermuda mystery may finally be solved as scientists reveal what's really hidden underneath
science.summary: Researchers from Carnegie Institution for Science and Yale University have investigated the geological mystery of Bermuda's elevation above the Atlantic Ocean. Their findings suggest that the island's unusual height may be attributed to its unique geological structure. This research could provide insights into the island's formation and contribute to understanding similar geological phenomena in other regions.

entertainment.title: Janhvi Kapoor Unhappy with Peddi Role? Rumors Spark Debate
entertainment.summary: Rumors have emerged suggesting Janhvi Kapoor is dissatisfied with her role in the upcoming film "Peddi," which is generating significant buzz ahead of its release. The movie marks Ram Charan's return to theaters after a year-long hiatus and is anticipated to be a major release next month. Fans are eagerly awaiting the film's debut amid these speculations.

entertainment.title: Salman forgives paps after hospital row but makes them say sorry 'zor se'
entertainment.summary: Salman Khan forgave paparazzi following a recent controversy during a hospital visit, requesting them to apologize "zor se" at the Raja Shivaji success party in Mumbai. The actor lightened the mood by joking with photographers while posing alongside Riteish Deshmukh, transforming a previously tense situation into a more relaxed atmosphere. The incident occurred on May 20.

entertainment.title: Salman Khan accepts paparazzi’s apology a day after heated exchange outside hospital: ‘Zor se sorry bolo’
entertainment.summary: Salman Khan accepted an apology from paparazzi after a heated exchange outside a hospital. The incident occurred when photographers followed him and shouted the name of his upcoming film, prompting Khan's frustration. At a recent event, he was seen posing with Riteish Deshmukh, where photographers apologized collectively. Khan responded positively, signaling a resolution to the earlier conflict.
